configured_watch_from_ea_inputs.resolution_rule: Filename-only open → MT5 MQL5/Files directory of the terminal running the EA

host_local_path_rule_from_script.first_matching_terminal_directory: script stops at first child of Terminal with MQL5 present

equivalence_reason: Different OS and path; freshness on Linux does not prove the Windows MQL5/Files copy contains the same bytes unless sync/mirror is verified on Windows.
sync_required: Producer or rsync/cloud-drive must append/copy to Windows MQL5\\Files file; repo documents this in docs/bridges/WINDOWS_CANONICAL_EA_CUTOVER.md
